授業概要
教育現場は、不登校・いじめ・体罰・ハラスメント・教師のストレス等、臨床心理学の支援が必要な状況に有る。教育現場の実態を理解し、それらをアセスメントし、支援する方法を考える。
An educational site is in the situation for which the support of the clinical psychology such as truancy, bullying, corporal punishment, harassment, and teacher's stresses is necessary. The assessment doing and the support method are devised by understanding the realities of an educational site, and devising them.
